items.item: initial dosing for patients weighing 100 kg or less
items.quote:
Subcutaneous Adult Dosage Regimen
• 
For patients weighing 100 kg or less, the recommended dosage is 45 mg initially and 4 weeks later,
followed by 45 mg every 12 weeks.
• 
For patients weighing more than 100 kg, the recommended dosage is 90 mg initially and 4 weeks 
later, followed by 90 mg every 12 weeks.
In subjects weighing more than 100 kg, 45 mg was also shown to be efficacious. However, 90 mg 
resulted in greater efficacy in these subjects [see Clinical Studies (14)].
